title: Brookings report recommends possible withholding of ET artifacts

tellings.quote: And even before that, NASA commissioned uh the Brookings report in 1959. It was published in 1960.

plain: Maaneli Derakhshani, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that NASA asked the Brookings Institution, a research group in Washington, to write a study in 1959, which came out in 1960. According to him, this Brookings report suggested that if signs of alien life, such as objects left behind, were ever found, the news might be held back from the public. If so, it would show that keeping such finds secret was thought about from NASA's earliest days.
